integrity: The reduction is symbolic and exact. The packaged verifier recomputes polynomial remainders, root exclusions, prime bounds, all divisibility pairs, quotient factor witnesses, and the four surviving equalities.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for \(n=p^a q\) with distinct primes, singleton cofactor exponent \(1\), and \(2\le a\le49\); no claim is made for larger exponents or two nontrivial exponents.
title: The first 49 exponent layers of the unitary–exponential divisor-sum equality
